missions.title: Make campus life flow
missions.description: Reimagine one everyday campus process that wastes people's time. Build a clear, accessible digital experience that makes the next step obvious.
constraints: Use sample data only; do not expose real student records.
outcomes: A testable prototype and a clear plan for a responsible pilot.

missions.title: Less waste, better days
missions.description: Help a community spot a small, measurable opportunity to reduce waste or make a shared resource go further.
constraints: Do not claim measured environmental savings without evidence.
outcomes: A prototype and a simple way to measure its intended impact.

missions.title: Open Innovation
missions.description: Bring a problem worth solving. Define who experiences it, show why current approaches fall short, and propose a thoughtful, testable solution.
constraints: An organizer must approve the problem framing before the team proceeds.
use_cases: A problem from your community, workplace, or campus.
outcomes: An organizer-reviewed idea and a demonstrable first solution.

faqs.question: Who can take part?
faqs.answer: SHOOT2CODE is an internal event. Eligibility details will be shared by the organizers.

faqs.question: Do we need a finished idea to register?
faqs.answer: No. Pick a mission to get started, or propose an Open Innovation idea for organizer approval.

faqs.question: What should we bring?
faqs.answer: Bring a laptop, your usual development tools, and a willingness to test ideas. Venue and format details will be confirmed by organizers.

faqs.question: How are projects judged?
faqs.answer: Projects are reviewed for impact, originality, usability, and technical execution. Mission-specific criteria appear on each mission card.
